daytime.title: Brunch / Lunch
daytime.intro: Our menu changes with the seasons while keeping a few core favourites. Expect nourishing food, simple plates and things we genuinely love to eat.

evening.title: Evening Menu
evening.intro: Our cheeses are carefully selected from award-winning Rennet & Rind. Our charcuterie comes from Sunday Charcuterie, known for 100% British cured meats. Both are best enjoyed with good bread, perhaps some olives, and naturally, a lovely glass of wine.

items.name: Baron Bigod
items.description: British cheese on toasted cranberry rye with fig & honey chutney

items.name: Delice de Bourgogne
items.description: our favourite French cheese, toasted focaccia & red onion chutney

items.name: Cheese Plate
items.description: Baron Bigod, Westcomb, Alpin Cheddar and The Duke. Sourdough crackers, gherkins, fig and honey chutney

items.name: Seasonal Salad
items.description: orzo, organic tomatoes, red onion, kale, toasted pistachios, basil, olive oil & balsamic dressing

items.name: Bread Plate
items.description: lightly toasted focaccia, cranberry rye & sourdough served with olive tapenade, oil & balsamic

items.name: Affogato

evening.additionalNote: Cheese & charcuterie boards are available to pre-order for groups of three or more. Just let us know when booking your table if you'd like one prepared for you.
